title: Pump kilowatt requirement as printed

symbols.definition: Total head to be got over in m

applicability: The kW of a pump shall be calculated as the printed equation. The following prose calls this the brake horse power and says actual horse power includes motor efficiency, about 0.95 for modern new motors and 0.9 for motors nearing a 15-year life cycle.
notes: Transcriber note: denominator 100.5 and the accented eta glyph ή are visibly printed. No physical constant, unit factor or formula correction has been substituted.
